name: llm
notes: CI (test.yml, matrix 3.10-3.14) runs `pip install . --group dev` and then `python -m pytest -vv`. The recipe mirrors this with uv (`--group $SRC/pyproject.toml:dev`, PEP 735). The dev group also pulls in sphinx/mypy/black/ruff, which are unused by pytest but kept to match CI. pytest.ini picks up the whole tests/ dir. All OpenAI HTTP is mocked with httpx2-pytest or replayed from vcr cassettes, and the autouse conftest sets LLM_USER_PATH to tmp. Nothing deselected and nothing skipped. I didn't run CI's non-pytest steps (cog, black, mypy, ruff, build, test-llm-load-plugins.sh, which installs plugins from PyPI). Resolved openai==3.29.0, httpx2==2.13.1. Common: setup runs from the router-migrate root (each step sources scripts/env.sh so uv caches/Pythons stay in .tools); --exclude-newer 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z pins dependency resolution to the baseline date. test_cmd sandboxes HOME and TMPDIR into $ENV/home and $ENV/tmp so tests never read or write the real ~ (e.g. ~/.config) or /tmp. Baseline was taken with outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed), so the tests are confirmed offline. Rebuilt from scratch into a second env (<name>-check): identical uv pip freeze and identical counts. Check-run counts: 1208 passed in 29.50s (30.8s).
